metadata.note: ai-explainer / claude-hai. AI Debt Tracker WEEK 5. ILLUSTRATE LAW: the Claude UI appears at B00 (cold open, answered), B09 (verdict artifact), B10 (handoff) and B11 (outro) only — every body beat illustrates its concept as a native animated Remotion scene (REBUILD LAW). The four source PNGs and their SVG sources are REFERENCE in pantry/, never slotted as media. The script's five body sections become eight body beats: 0:15 splits into the graph (B01) and the ledger engine with its borrowed opening (B02); 0:50 splits into the two metrics (B03) and the new bonds the first metric is about (B04); 1:15 splits into the 66 additions (B05) and the timing bug (B06); 1:55 becomes B07; and the closing on-camera section becomes a limits beat. FIVE THINGS NOT TO GET WRONG: this is a TRADE — recall rose and precision fell, and no frame shows one without the other; the opening ledger was BORROWED from the answer key, so the tracker is not reading its own start; the diagnosis of the 26 wrong additions is Claude's judgment, not a person's; the reader is still NOT more accurate than a single model call (91% against 96%); and the week's gate records DELEGATED, not cleared.
